node_definition.done_when: Done when a new test file shows: closing a plan whose done sections each have a landing comment succeeds; closing one with a done section that states a done-when and has neither a landing comment nor a run record is refused and the refusal names the section; adding the comment lets the same close succeed; and a done section that states no done-when and has no comment does not stop a close. Negative controls: with the check removed, the second close succeeds, and a check that ignores whether the section states a done-when refuses the fourth. The new refusal is also run against the live store, and the count of open plans it would refuse is recorded in the manifest. The test files that import the close operation add no failure against the base revision.
